name: Gyokuto (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Gyokuto town emblem in white: a disc with a notch at the fly enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Gyokuto, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1967.

features.role: Gyokuto town emblem — a disc with a notch at the fly enclosing a stylised device
